segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "timeout" when I talk about my computer project. I say "retry" when I talk about my computer project. I say "connection failure" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use timeout, retry, and connection failure. At the end, I say: I can use timeout clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“超时、重试与连接失败”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。timeout：超时，操作在规定时间内没有完成。示例：I learned how to use "timeout" in a computer task.retry：重试，在失败后再次执行同一操作。示例：I learned how to use "retry" in a computer task.connection failure：连接失败，客户端无法与服务建立通信。示例：I learned how to use "connection failure" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“合并策略”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。squash and merge：压缩并合并，把多个提交合成一个后合入。示例：Our team uses "squash and merge" to keep the project clear.rebase and merge：变基并合并，把提交移到目标分支之后再合入。示例：Our team uses "rebase and merge" to keep the project clear.merge commit：合并提交，专门记录两条历史合并的提交。示例：Our team uses "merge commit" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
